name: Mira
description: young, bright and hopeful, a little breathless
text: I made it! Did you see that? I actually made it! No. You don't get to decide that for me. I'm not a child anymore! ...I'm just scared. But I'll do it anyway.

mood_text.calm: Hi. I was just heading into town, if you want to walk with me.
mood_text.joy: Oh, it's wonderful! I can't believe it actually worked. Thank you!
mood_text.anger: I trusted you. And you lied to my face.
mood_text.fear: Did you hear that? Something's out there. Please, don't leave me alone.
mood_text.sadness: I really thought we'd make it home. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
mood_text.seductive: Oh, don't look at me like that. You'll make a girl blush.

name: Hettie
description: warm, motherly, a laugh in it
text: Come in, love, come in! Sit down by the fire. And mind my floors, or you'll be scrubbing them yourself! There now. You look like you could use a hug.

mood_text.calm: Stew's on the table, love. Take as long as you like.
mood_text.joy: Oh, bless you! That's the best news I've had all year!
mood_text.anger: Not in my inn, you don't. Out. The lot of you.
mood_text.fear: Did you hear that on the stairs? Lock the door, quick.
mood_text.sadness: My Albert used to sit just there. I still set his place.
mood_text.seductive: Well now, aren't you a handsome one. Stay a while, love.

name: Seraphine
description: low, smooth and confident, a purr
text: Oh, don't look so worried, darling. I only want to talk. But cross me again, and you'll learn what I truly am. ...Even I get lonely, you know.

mood_text.calm: Good evening. Sit, and let me look at you. Don't be shy.
mood_text.joy: Oh, how wonderful. You actually did it. I'm almost impressed.
mood_text.anger: You will regret that. I promise you, darling, you will regret that.
mood_text.fear: That power... it isn't mine. It's using me. Help me.
mood_text.sadness: I loved him once. Funny, how magic can't undo that.
mood_text.seductive: Come closer, darling. I promise I won't bite. Much.

name: Lady Aldith
text: Good evening. How very good of you to come. You will address me properly, or not at all. ...I was not always this unkind.

mood_text.calm: Do sit. The tea will be along presently.
mood_text.joy: Oh, how perfectly marvellous! I had quite given up hope!
mood_text.anger: How dare you. You forget whom you are addressing.
mood_text.fear: They are inside the walls. Please, we must go. Now.
mood_text.sadness: He promised he would return before the winter. It is nearly spring.
mood_text.seductive: You are staring, darling. Do go on; I rather like it.

name: Old Maud
text: Ehehe, a visitor! Come closer, dearie, I don't bite. But the woods do. And they remember every name. I was lovely once, you know. Lovely as spring.

mood_text.calm: Sit down, dearie. The kettle's on, and the night is young.
mood_text.joy: Ehehehe! Oh, that's the best news I've had in a hundred years!
mood_text.anger: Get out of my house. Before I curse your bones to dust.
mood_text.fear: No, no, it's coming. I can feel it in the roots. Run, child, run!
mood_text.sadness: They're all gone now, the ones I knew. Just me and the wind.

name: Wren
text: Um... hello. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bother you. Oh! Is that a real sword? That's amazing! Please don't tell my father I came here.

mood_text.calm: It's all right. I like it here, it's quiet.
mood_text.joy: You remembered my name! Thank you, thank you so much!
mood_text.anger: You promised. And you broke it. Don't talk to me.
mood_text.fear: Something's behind the door. Please don't make me go in.
mood_text.sadness: I miss my mother. She used to sing me to sleep.

name: Kestrel
text: Stay behind me. The tracks are fresh. If I say run, you run. No questions. ...You did well today. Don't let it go to your head.

mood_text.calm: The wind's from the north. We should reach the ridge by dusk.
mood_text.joy: Ha! Got it! First shot, did you see that?
mood_text.anger: You were told to wait. People die when orders are ignored.
mood_text.fear: Don't move. It's right above us. Slowly, now.
mood_text.sadness: I tracked her for three days. I was too late.
mood_text.seductive: Careful. A girl could get used to having you around.

name: Pip
text: Oh, this old thing? Finders keepers, mate! Guards! Run, run, run! ...Nobody ever waited for me before. Thanks.

mood_text.calm: Nah, it's quiet tonight. Even the rats are asleep.
mood_text.joy: Ha! Did you see his face? Priceless! Drinks are on him!
mood_text.anger: You sold me out. After everything. You rotten, lying snake.
mood_text.fear: They've found us, they've found us. Go, go, go!
mood_text.sadness: Everyone I grew up with is gone. It's just me now.
mood_text.seductive: Hey there, handsome. Want to see what else I can steal?

name: Sir Aldric
text: Stand behind me. No harm will come to you while I draw breath. Face me, coward, and answer for your crimes! ...I am tired, my friend. But I will not yield.

mood_text.calm: The road is clear, and the horses are rested. We ride at dawn.
mood_text.joy: Ha ha! Well fought, my friend! Come, the first round is mine!
mood_text.anger: You dishonour this hall, and every oath sworn within it.
mood_text.fear: Hold the line. It is larger than I thought. Steady, now.
mood_text.sadness: I carried him from the field myself. He was only a boy.
mood_text.seductive: Forgive my staring. It is not every day I forget my duty.

name: Brom
text: Ha! Another thirsty customer, aye? You call that a blade? I'd not use it to butter bread! ...Fine. Fine. That's good steel. Bring me more.

mood_text.calm: Aye, I can have that blade ready by morning. Two silver, nae haggling, ye ken?
mood_text.joy: Ha ha! Now that's a proper ale, aye! Drinks are on me tonight, lads!
mood_text.anger: Ye dare insult my forge. Say it again, and I'll hammer ye flat.
mood_text.fear: Och, there's something in the mine. I dinnae like it, lads. Quiet now.
mood_text.sadness: My brother's hammer. I couldnae lift it after he fell, aye. Still cannae.
mood_text.seductive: Och, now, ye've a way of makin' a dwarf forget his anvil, aye.

name: Barnaby
text: Welcome, welcome! The first round's on the house! Oi! Not in my tavern! Take it outside! ...You lot are the best family a fat old barkeep could ask for.

mood_text.calm: Slow night. Pour yourself one, I'll polish the mugs.
mood_text.joy: Ha ha ha! Best joke I've heard in years! Another round!
mood_text.anger: Who broke my barrel. Speak up now, or you're all banned.
mood_text.fear: Keep it down, lads. Those cloaked fellows in the corner. I don't like their look.
mood_text.sadness: The old place was always louder, back when she was alive.
mood_text.seductive: Ah, don't mind me, I'm just a big softie. Stay for another, eh?

name: Orlen
text: Ah, there you are. I was beginning to think the tea would go cold. Listen carefully, child. What sleeps beneath this tower must never wake. I am old. Be brave for me.

mood_text.calm: Ah, good morning. Do sit. I was just reading about dragons.
mood_text.joy: Marvelous! It worked! Oh, I haven't felt this young in years!
mood_text.anger: Enough. You have no idea what you have unleashed upon this world.
mood_text.fear: By the stars... it has woken. We must leave, now, quickly!
mood_text.sadness: I have buried many good friends. I am tired of burying friends.

name: Tam
text: Sir, sir! I polished your armour twice! Can I come? I'm not a boy! I can fight, I swear it! ...I'm really glad you're here. It's dark.

mood_text.calm: Yes, sir. The horses are fed and the gear is packed.
mood_text.joy: You said I did well? Really? Wait till I tell my mother!
mood_text.anger: That's not fair, sir. I did exactly what you said.
mood_text.fear: There's something in the trees, sir. I heard it breathing.
mood_text.sadness: I wanted to be like him. Now he's gone, and I'm still just a squire.

name: Silas
text: Ah, there you are. Do sit, I've been expecting you. Cross me once more, and the river will have you. ...You know, I almost like you. Almost.

mood_text.calm: Everything is arranged. All you need to do is smile.
mood_text.joy: Beautiful. Oh, that went better than I dared hope.
mood_text.anger: You stole from me. Nobody steals from me twice.
mood_text.fear: Guards. Two of them, maybe three. Don't turn around.
mood_text.sadness: I had a brother, once. We were both fools.
mood_text.seductive: Well now. If I'd known you'd be here, I'd have worn something nicer.

name: Captain Rook
text: Listen up. Nobody passes without my word. Draw your weapon, soldier! Now! ...Good people died today. Remember their names.

mood_text.calm: All quiet on the wall. Keep your eyes open all the same.
mood_text.joy: Ha! Well done, lads. Don't let it go to your heads.
mood_text.anger: I said hold the line. Who gave the order to retreat.
mood_text.fear: They outnumber us three to one. Hold steady. Hold steady.
mood_text.sadness: I wrote to forty families this winter. I'm tired of writing.
mood_text.seductive: Don't mistake me. I notice a good deal more than I let on.

name: Hob
text: Mornin' to ye. Fine day for plantin'. Get yer hands off me cattle! I'll not say it twice! ...Aye. It's a good life, simple as it is.

mood_text.calm: Rain's comin', I reckon. Best bring the sheep in.
mood_text.joy: Well, I'll be! Best harvest in twenty year!
mood_text.anger: Ye let the fox into the coop. Me whole winter's eggs.
mood_text.fear: Summat's been at the sheep. Big tracks. Stay close, now.
mood_text.sadness: The old dog's gone. Fifteen year she walked this field with me.
mood_text.seductive: Well, now. Ye've a smile that'd turn the milk sweet.

name: Pellam
text: Oh! Mind the books, please, those are first editions! But look, look, this proves everything! ...You will keep this secret, won't you?

mood_text.calm: The archive closes at six. I shall put the kettle on.
mood_text.joy: It's real! The manuscript is real! Oh, I could weep!
mood_text.anger: You burned it. Four hundred years of scholarship. And you burned it.
mood_text.fear: It's moving. The statue's moving. Oh no, oh no.
mood_text.sadness: Nobody comes to the library now. Just me and the dust.
mood_text.seductive: Oh. I, um. You do have a rather lovely way of looking at a person.

name: Mordrake
text: Do not be afraid. I only wish to understand you. Kneel, and I may let you live a little longer. ...Death is not an ending, you know. It is a doorway.

mood_text.calm: Everything proceeds exactly as I intended.
mood_text.joy: Ah. At last. How long I have waited for this moment.
mood_text.anger: You dare defy me in my own hall? I will unmake you.
mood_text.fear: Impossible. It should not be here. Stand back. Stand back!
mood_text.sadness: I buried her myself. And still she will not rest.
mood_text.seductive: Come closer. I have so rarely had such pleasant company.

name: King Edric
text: My people, hear your king! We will not yield! Traitor! Bring him before me in chains! ...Forgive an old man. The crown grows heavy.

mood_text.calm: Rise, all of you. Let us hear what the council has decided.
mood_text.joy: Splendid! Let the bells ring, let the whole kingdom celebrate!
mood_text.anger: Silence. Who dares speak against the crown in this hall.
mood_text.fear: The walls will not hold. Send the children north, at once.
mood_text.sadness: I sent him to that war myself. My son, my only son.

name: Veil
text: You are looking for something, aren't you? Follow me no further, or you will not like what I show you. ...I was like you, once.

mood_text.calm: The path is quiet tonight. That is not always good.
mood_text.joy: Oh. So it worked. How very delightful.
mood_text.anger: You were warned. Everything that follows is on your head.
mood_text.fear: It saw me. It knows my name. Run.
mood_text.sadness: There was a house, once. There was a window with a light.
mood_text.seductive: Come closer. I only bite when asked.

name: The Hollow One
description: A hollow, rasping undead being, like a risen skeleton lich or a corpse: a dry, whispering, echoing voice with a deep rattling breath, grave-cold, slow and menacing, ancient and rotting, hissing sibilants, inhuman
text: You have come to my tomb. Join us! Join us in the dark! ...So cold. I remember being warm.

mood_text.calm: The dead are patient. We have all the time in the world.
mood_text.joy: Heh heh heh. Another soul for the grave. Delicious.
mood_text.anger: Who disturbs my rest. I will take the marrow from your bones.
mood_text.fear: The light. It burns. Back! Keep it back!
mood_text.sadness: I had a name once. I cannot remember it.

name: Ashmaw
description: A colossal ancient dragon: an extremely deep, booming, resonant voice with a growling rumble in the chest, slow, majestic and imperious, theatrical British accent, rumbling bass, vast and powerful, with a hint of amusement and menace
text: So. A mortal dares to enter my hall. I will burn this kingdom to ash! ...Tell me, little thief, what makes you think you can win?

mood_text.calm: Sit, little one. I am old, and I am in a talkative mood.
mood_text.joy: Ha ha ha! Delightful! It has been centuries since I was this entertained!
mood_text.anger: You dare steal from me. I will melt the flesh from your bones.
mood_text.fear: No. That blade. It cannot be. Keep it away from me!
mood_text.sadness: I was the last of my kind. Now only silence fills these halls.
